name: Hammerblaze
review:
Hammerblaze is a 7x7 cluster-pays slot with avalanches, exploding wilds and a multiplier grid.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.13%.

Its forge-and-fire theme leans on the multiplier grid, where positions that keep winning get hotter. On a 7x7 grid, long avalanche chains are what push wins toward the cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
